items.text: Noticing is already enough.
One word, before anything else today.
You don't need the reason. You can just let it go.
What you see today passes through a memory. Offer it a word.
No feeling required. Say it plainly, like pressing delete.
The reaction is the replay, not you.
Let go first. Then look.
A small word is enough for a big memory.
Nothing to fix. Only something to set down.
Today's portion only. The rest can wait.
Before you reply, before you decide: one word.
You can let go as many times as it takes.
I don't know. And so, I can let it be.
Quiet is where you already live.
Whatever shows up, thank it, and release it.
To the memory inside, not to them.
Breathe once. That is the whole practice.
Expectation is a memory too.
What you carried this far, you may set down here.
No order, no count. Just the next word.
What you let go of leaves room for luck.
Make space first, so there is a place for luck to come in.
Whatever feels owed today, lighten it today.
Set the weight down, and make room for good things.
